hero.title: Balance Chemical Equations

input.label: Enter a chemical equation
input.placeholder: e.g. KMnO4 + HCl = KCl + MnCl2 + Cl2 + H2O

steps.title: Step-by-step Mathematical Solution
steps.subtitle: Algorithmic Gaussian elimination of the linear material balance matrix
steps.step1Desc: Identifying all unique chemical elements present across reactants and products.
steps.step2Desc: Formulating linear conservation of mass equations for each element.
steps.step3Desc: Applying row operations to reduce the matrix and obtain fractional coefficients.
steps.step4Desc: Multiplying by the least common multiple (LCM) to obtain lowest whole numbers.

about.missionText: To make chemistry accessible, visual, and engaging for every student without dry memorization. We integrate 3D modeling, algorithmic equation solvers, and comprehensive exam preparation into a unified educational ecosystem.

audiences.desc: For mastering school chemistry curriculum and safely exploring chemical reactions.
For effective profile test preparation with curated solutions and analytics.

For exploring chemical phenomena occurring in everyday life, cooking, and industry.

about.safetySubtitle: Essential safety protocols for conducting practical chemistry experiments
safetyRules: Conduct laboratory work only in properly equipped chemistry rooms under teacher supervision.
Wear protective goggles and a lab coat. Avoid getting acids and bases on skin or in eyes.
Never taste chemicals or inhale vapors and gases directly.
When diluting, always pour acid slowly into water while stirring (never pour water into acid).
All simulations in the ChemLab virtual laboratory are 100% safe.
